Name: SleepyHead - Pause Time
Author: remnantsoldier
Description:
Go ahead.
Grab a drink while the next day loads or just lay in bed longer~
Your game will wait.
[size=1][i]Poor guy is probably exhausted[/i][/size]

[u][size=3]Description:[/size][/u]

Time will pause every morning until you leave your bed.

Options include pausing time whenever you're in bed or sitting down. (Defaulted OFF)

Includes [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] support

[u][size=3]Compatibility
[/size][/u]
Tested in singleplayer with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/169]TimeSpeed[/url]
